item.description: Dodgers beat Braves 3-1 at Truist Park as Freeman and Enrique Hernández homers and Yamamoto’s 10 K gem put LA up 2-1 in the MLB Postseason.

headerTranslation.fr: Les Dodgers battent les Braves 3-1 à Atlanta grâce à la performance éclatante de Yamamoto
headerTranslation.es: Dodgers vencen a Braves 3-1 en Atlanta con brillante actuación de Yamamoto
headerTranslation.pt: Dodgers vencem Braves por 3-1 em Atlanta com destaque para Yamamoto
headerTranslation.it: I Dodgers battono i Braves 3-1 ad Atlanta, Yamamoto brilla

descriptionTranslation.fr: Les Dodgers battent les Braves 3-1 au Truist Park grâce aux circuits de Freeman et Enrique Hernández et à la démonstration de 10 retraits sur prises de Yamamoto, plaçant LA en tête 2-1 dans la MLB Postseason.
descriptionTranslation.es: Los Dodgers vencen a los Braves 3-1 en Truist Park gracias a los jonrones de Freeman y Enrique Hernández y la joya de 10 ponches de Yamamoto, poniéndose 2-1 arriba en la MLB Postseason.
descriptionTranslation.pt: Dodgers vencem os Braves por 3-1 no Truist Park: home runs de Freeman e Enrique Hernández e a joia de 10 eliminações de Yamamoto colocam LA em vantagem de 2-1 na MLB Postseason.
descriptionTranslation.it: I Dodgers battono i Braves 3-1 al Truist Park grazie ai fuoricampo di Freeman ed Enrique Hernández e alla gemma da 10 K di Yamamoto, portando LA sul 2-1 nella MLB Postseason.

item.header: Dodgers beat Braves 3-1 in Atlanta as Yamamoto shines
